summary: Phase PORTAL.0 (unified access-context + design-independent portal) fully verified on WEB. Backend GET /api/portal/context returns correct workspaces for admin/merchant-owner/consumer and is genuinely design-agnostic (query-string ?design=... does not affect access). Web /portal/login renders with all required data-testids under every design variant (legacy / classic_b / radiolife / new_look_v2). Login as demo@bigfm.dubai (2 owned merchants) → chooser with 2 workspace buttons → picking one navigates to /merchant/status?merchant_id=<that id>. WorkspaceSwitcher in the V2 header opens a menu of both workspaces and switching navigates to the correct merchant status without logout. /business/login correctly redirects to /portal/login via React Router Navigate. Freeuser (no workspaces) is redirected from /portal to '/' and does not see the WorkspaceSwitcher. All 12 pytest cases and all playwright flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: portal_context.py: advertiser aggregation is wrapped in a broad try/except that only logs at DEBUG — a real schema failure would silently drop advertiser workspaces. Consider logging at WARNING with the error class.

usePortalAccess.fetch(): on error the store sets `loaded:true` with empty workspaces, so a transient 5xx would look identical to a legitimate consumer and route the user to '/'. A retry or a distinct `error` flag would prevent this masking (not blocking for Phase 0).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase PORTAL.0 web is fully green. Backend regression at /app/backend/tests/test_portal_context.py (12 tests). Playwright coverage: portal-login testids, /business/login redirect, demo→chooser (2 real workspaces), pick→/merchant/status?merchant_id=<id>, WorkspaceSwitcher (trigger+menu+options) switching between merchants without logout, freeuser→'/', design-override cannot elevate a consumer's access, and /portal/login renders under all 4 design variants.
